refnamediv.refpurpose: Reads remainder of a stream into a string

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.parameters;
stream (resource)
A stream resource (e.g. returned from fopen)
length (?int)
The maximum bytes to read. Defaults to &null;, which, like -1, reads until the end of the stream. The length counts bytes after the read filters. On a non-blocking socket, or after a timeout, a shorter string is returned.
offset (int)
Seek to the specified offset before reading. The offset is an absolute position from the start of the stream, not relative to the current position. If this number is negative, no seeking will occur and reading will start from the current position. On a stream that cannot seek (a pipe, a socket or http://), a forward offset is emulated by reading and discarding data, whereas a backward offset emits E_WARNING messages and returns &false;. On a stream with read filters, the offset counts unfiltered bytes.

&reftitle.returnvalues;
Returns a string, or &false; if seeking to offset fails. A read error ends the read, and the data read so far (possibly an empty string) is returned.

&reftitle.errors;
Throws a ValueError if length is less than -1.
